changelog:
Major update with new security mitigations, workflows, and MCP server support.

- Version bumped to 3.0 with updated binary installation instructions.
- Enhanced security & privacy rules: domain allowlist, local password gates for production, agent zero-knowledge enforcement, and cryptographically chained audit log.
- Agent commands clarified: agents cannot retrieve plaintext secrets, only list/operate.
- Added support and usage instructions for Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (API tool registration and serving).
- Improved outbound call protections: DNS rebinding/SSRF defense, session token in CLI requests.
- New audit and forensic verification commands (`log`, `log verify`, `log replay`).
- Added explicit environment injection warnings and documentation search/download instructions.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
summary: Zero-knowledge secrets infrastructure — AI agents manage the complete credential lifecycle without ever seeing values
